title: WaveST-Yield: a novel spatio-temporal deep learning framework with frequency-domain refinement for UAV-based maize yield prediction.
summary: WaveST-Yield predicts maize yield across two fields with cross-plot external validation, supporting a specific agricultural result.

evidence.tested: WaveST-Yield was evaluated on two fields with five-fold cross-validation and cross-plot validation against measured yield; reported R² was 0.883 and 0.775 for the two fields.
evidence.unknown: The reported evaluation does not establish prospective benefit or performance beyond the studied setting.
evidence.ai_role: Combines ConvLSTM phenology encoding, wavelet frequency refinement and 3D-CBAM attention to estimate maize yield from UAV multispectral time series.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
